name: Wild Sarsaparilla
desc: Wild Sarsaparilla (Aralia nudicaulis): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 10 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Aralia nudicaulis (commonly wild sarsaparilla, false sarsaparilla, shot bush, small spikenard, wild liquorice, and rabbit root) is a species of flowering plant in the ivy family Araliaceae.
